title: Oven Roasted Mexican Beef Birria
description: A rich and crispy solo dinner Mexican dish featuring dried apricots and salt bake, paleo friendly and in the form of birria.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine chopped onion, minced garlic, chili powder, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped dried apricots to the bowl and mix well.
Add the beef brisket to the bowl and coat with the onion and spice mixture.
Place the beef brisket in a large Dutch oven and add the tomato paste and beef broth.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Roast the beef for 3 hours or until tender.
Remove the lid and continue roasting for an additional 30 minutes or until crispy.
Remove the birria from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
